from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,struct,zlib,os,datetime
from datetime import datetime as D,timezone
p=Path('/Users/robault/GitHub/sugata-avatar/docs/evidence/appearance-2026-10-19/knit-character-turnaround')
print('PID',os.getpid(),'UTC',datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
a=json.loads((p/'ADMISSION.json').read_text());g=json.loads((p/'GENERATION-RESULT.json').read_text());intent=json.loads((p/'GENERATION-INTENT.json').read_text());r=json.loads((p/'REQUEST.json').read_text());si=json.loads((p/'SOURCE-INPUTS.json').read_text());rf=json.loads((p/'ROOT-IMAGE-FIRST.json').read_text());rows={}
for row in a['bindings']+g['bindings']+rf['bindings']+si['pins']+[intent['admission'],intent['request'],g['default_output'],g['project_copy']]:
 b=Path(row['path']).read_bytes();actual={'path':row['path'],'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()};assert actual==row,(actual,row);assert row['path'] not in rows or rows[row['path']]==row;rows[row['path']]=row
assert intent['arguments']==r and r['prompt']==(p/'PROMPT.txt').read_text()
assert g['tool_metadata']['arguments_source']=='REQUEST.json' and g['tool_metadata']['dispatches']==1 and g['reported_local_png_count']==1
assert g['tool_metadata']['tool']==a['tool']==intent['tool']=='image_gen.imagegen'
start=D.strptime(g['tool_metadata']['start']['current_time'],'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC').replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc);finish=D.strptime(g['tool_metadata']['finish']['current_time'],'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC').replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
assert D.fromisoformat(a['utc'])<=start<=finish<D.fromisoformat(a['expires_utc'])
b=Path(g['project_copy']['path']).read_bytes();assert b==Path(g['default_output']['path']).read_bytes()
assert b[:8]==b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n';i=8;chunks=[];header=None
while i<len(b):
 n=struct.unpack('>I',b[i:i+4])[0];k=b[i+4:i+8];d=b[i+8:i+8+n];crc=struct.unpack('>I',b[i+8+n:i+12+n])[0];assert zlib.crc32(k+d)&0xffffffff==crc
 chunks.append({'type':k.decode(),'bytes':n})
 if k==b'IHDR':header=struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB',d)
 i+=n+12

w,h,depth,color,_,_,interlace=header
assert [w,h,depth,color,interlace]==[1536,1024,8,2,0] and len(b)<=15*1024*1024 and max(w,h)<=4096 and w*h<=8388608
print(json.dumps({'binding_rows_checked':len(a['bindings'])+len(g['bindings'])+len(rf['bindings'])+len(si['pins'])+4,'unique_bound_paths_checked':len(rows),'intent_arguments_equal_request':True,'reported_argument_source':'REQUEST.json','within_admission':True,'default_project_exact':True,'PNG_bytes':len(b),'PNG_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'header':header,'chunks':chunks,'all_CRCs':True,'caps_pass':True,'no_comparison_image_view':True},indent=2))
